title: Verification is relaxed only where a `capabilities.tls` grant names the host and the call asks for it, and no such grant has a `true` spelling
divergesFromPhp: `CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER = false` is one line of userland; here the same effect needs the deployment to name the host in a grant and the call to ask for it, and the boot prints every grant that was written
